items.title: Round Spectacles
items.author: Sean Buckley
items.note: Hero glasses, the exploded frame and the finishes. 2K glTF re-encoded once (meshopt, WebP), all 11,810 triangles kept. The page splits it into its own connected pieces and measures them; the wire is shown in warm gold and the four finishes, the lens glass is replaced by our refraction shader. Same file on phone and desktop.
